name: Mibsam
overview: The name Mibsam appears in Scripture as a descendant in two distinct genealogies, highlighting the continuity of God's providential care over His people across generations. Mibsam is listed among the sons of Ishmael, emphasizing his role within the lineage of Abraham's firstborn son, as recorded in Genesis 25:13 and 1 Chronicles 1:29. Additionally, Mibsam is noted as a son of Shallum in 1 Chronicles 4:25, demonstrating the preservation of family lines within the tribe of Judah. These references collectively underscore the biblical emphasis on heritage and God's faithfulness in maintaining His promises through successive generations.
